shortDescription: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall said TikTok has agreed to pay up to $300 million and adopt new user protection measures to settle the state’s child-safety lawsuit, according to Bloomberg.The case was set for a jury trial to begin Monday.

children: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall said TikTok has agreed to pay up to $300 million and adopt new user protection measures to settle the state’s child-safety lawsuit, according to Bloomberg.
The case was set for a jury trial to begin Monday.

title: TikTok Agrees to Pay Alabama Up to $300 Million in Child-Safety Settlement
